entries.question: Mujhe psychiatrist ko dikhana hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein psychiatrist ko dikhane ke liye aap niche diye gaye steps ka palan kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment (Anivarya/Mandatory):**
KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration karwana anivarya hai. Aap [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jaakar ya "ABHA/Health Care App" ke zariye appointment book kar sakte hain.

**2. OPD Timing:**
*   **Din:** Somvar (Monday) se Shukravar (Friday) tak subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 1:00 baje tak.
*   **Shaniwar (Saturday):** Subah 9:00 baje se 12:00 baje tak.
*   **Ravivar (Sunday):** OPD band rehti hai.

**3. OPD Slip Fee:**
OPD slip ki fee ₹50 hai, jise aap online ya hospital counter par jama kar sakte hain.

**4. Location:**
Psychiatry Department "Shah Mina Road Belt" par sthit hai. Aap Gate 2 (Main Hospital/OPD) se enter hokar wahan pahunch sakte hain.

**Mahatvapurn Sujhaav:**
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne saath kisi doctor ka referral letter zaroor layein.
*   **Personal Safety:** Kripya apni koi bhi vyaktigat jaankari (jaise phone number, Aadhaar number, ya medical reports) is chat mein share na karein.
*   **Emergency:** Agar koi gambhir sthiti ho, toh aap sidhe Trauma Centre (Gate 14) ja sakte hain.

Main ek AI hoon, isliye main medical salah nahi de sakta. Agar aapko koi mansik pareshani hai, toh kripya KGMU ke Psychiatry department mein doctor se sampark karein.

KGMU में OPD अपॉइंटमेंट लेने के मुख्य तरीके निम्नलिखित हैं:

1. **ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट (ORS):** आप [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाकर अपना रजिस्ट्रेशन कर सकते हैं और KGMU चुनकर विभाग, तारीख और समय के अनुसार अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं। इसके लिए ₹50 का शुल्क ऑनलाइन देना होता है।
2. **SMS के द्वारा:** आप अपने मोबाइल से `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भेज सकते हैं।
3. **वॉक-इन (Walk-in):** आप सीधे अस्पताल आकर भी अपॉइंटमेंट ले सकते हैं। इसके लिए अपना आधार कार्ड और सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर साथ लाएं। अस्पताल में OTP के माध्यम से टोकन प्राप्त करें और ₹50 का शुल्क जमा करके OPD पर्ची प्राप्त करें।
4. **हेल्पलाइन:** अधिक जानकारी के लिए आप **0522-2258880** या **0522-3539333** पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
* OPD का समय: सोमवार–शुक्रवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक) और शनिवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक)। रविवार को OPD बंद रहती है।
* पर्ची काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाता है, इसलिए समय का ध्यान रखें।
* बाहर के मरीजों के लिए संबंधित विभाग का रेफरल पत्र साथ लाना अनिवार्य है। 
* किसी भी चिकित्सा सलाह के लिए कृपया KGMU के डॉक्टर से संपर्क करें। सुरक्षा के लिए कृपया इस चैट में अपनी निजी जानकारी (जैसे आधार नंबर या फोन नंबर) साझा न करें।

entries.question: Npjr form mbbs doctor not studied in kgmu
entries.answer:
It appears you are looking for a "No Objection" or "No Pending Dues" related certificate/form for an MBBS doctor who did not graduate from KGMU.

Please note that **KGMU cannot issue a "No Objection" or "No Dues" certificate for an individual who was not a student or employee of this institution.** These documents are official records confirming that an individual has no outstanding financial or academic liabilities to the university.

If you are applying for a position, training, or registration at KGMU and require a "No Objection" from your parent institution, you must:

1.  **Contact your Alma Mater:** You should request the required "No Objection" or "Experience/Character" certificate directly from the Medical College or University where you completed your MBBS.
2.  **Verify KGMU Requirements:** If a specific department at KGMU has requested this document from you as part of an application (e.g., for a residency or project post), please check the specific **Recruitment Notice** or **Admission Guidelines** on the [KGMU website](https://www.kgmu.org/) to see the exact format required.
3.  **Contact the Registrar/Dean:** If you are unsure about the documentation required for a specific KGMU process, you may contact the **Registrar Office at 0522-2253171** or the office of the relevant department head for clarification on what documentation is accepted for external candidates.

If you are a candidate for a specific project or position listed in the current notices (such as the SIB SHInE position or other project vacancies), please refer to the specific recruitment notice PDF for details on required documentation: [https://www.kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://www.kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)

entries.question: Mujhe  cardiology department ka opimement chahiye
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Cardiology department (LARI Cardiology) mein appointment lene ke liye aap niche diye gaye tarikon ka upyog kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment (Mandatory/Recommended):**
*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login/register karein, Uttar Pradesh aur phir KGMU select karein. Cardiology department chunein aur ₹50 ka shulk (fee) bharkar appointment slip download karein.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** Iske madhyam se bhi aap hospital aur department select karke appointment book kar sakte hain.

**2. SMS dwara:**
*   Aap `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.

**3. Walk-in (Offline):**
*   Aap hospital jakar bhi token le sakte hain. Iske liye aapko apna Aadhaar card aur active mobile number saath rakhna hoga. OTP verification ke baad ₹50 ka parchi shulk dekar token prapt karein.

**Mahatvapurn Jaankari:**
*   **OPD Samay:** Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Referral:** Yadi aap Lucknow se bahar ke patient hain, toh kripya Cardiology department ke liye valid referral letter saath layein.
*   **Parchi Counter:** Parchi counter dopahar 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchne ka prayas karein.

*Note: Main ek AI hoon aur medical advice nahi de sakta. Yadi aapko emergency mehsoos ho rahi hai, toh turant KGMU ke Trauma Centre (Gate 14) par jayein.*

entries.question: Bookings appointment cardiologist
entries.answer:
To book an appointment with a cardiologist at KGMU, please follow these steps:

**Online Registration (Mandatory):**
1.  **ORS Portal:** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU. Choose the Cardiology department, select your preferred date/time, provide patient details, and pay the ₹50 fee. Download your appointment slip.
2.  **ABHA/Health Care App:** You can also use the ABHA app to register and follow the same hospital selection flow.
3.  **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

**Important Information:**
*   **Walk-in:** If you visit in person, you must bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP. You will then receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.
*   **Referral:** Patients traveling from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department.
*   **Timings:** OPD registration is open Monday–Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. The ticket counters close at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book your appointment in advance to avoid long wait times.

**Contact:**
*   For urgent queries, you may contact the Lari Cardiology PRO office at **9415099528**.
*   General KGMU Helpline: **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

*Note: I am an AI, not a doctor. If this is a medical emergency, please proceed directly to the KGMU Trauma Centre (Gate 14) or the nearest emergency facility.*

entries.question: Kya document lgte hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein admission process ke liye kaun se documents chahiye honge, yeh aapke course aur admission category (Entrance exam/Counseling) par nirbhar karta hai. Aam taur par, aapko ye mool (original) documents aur unki photocopy apne saath rakhni chahiye:

1. **Academic Documents:**
   - 10th ki Marksheet aur Certificate (Date of Birth verification ke liye).
   - 12th ki Marksheet aur Certificate (Physics, Chemistry, Biology ke saath).
   - Agar aapne entrance exam diya hai, toh uska **Admit Card** aur **Rank/Result Card**.
   - Transfer Certificate (TC) aur Migration Certificate.

2. **Personal/Identity Documents:**
   - Aadhaar Card (ya koi anya valid Govt. ID).
   - Passport size photos (jitni notice mein maangi gayi hon).

3. **Category/Reservation Documents (yadi लागू ho):**
   - Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC) – Uttar Pradesh sarkar dwara jaari hona chahiye.
   - EWS Certificate (yadi apply kiya hai).
   - Income Certificate (kuch scholarships ya fees ke liye).

4. **Anye:**
   - Character Certificate (school/college se).
   - Affidavit (agar gap year ho toh).
   - Allotment Letter (counseling ke baad).

**Zaroori Salah:**
*   Sahi aur current list ke liye, KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jaakar apne course ka **"Admission Brochure"** ya **"Information Brochure"** zaroor download karein. Usmein har document ki list aur format ki jaankari di hoti hai.
*   Personal details jaise Aadhaar number ya phone number yahan chat mein share na karein, yeh aapki suraksha ke liye hai.

Kya aapne kisi khaas entrance exam ke liye apply kiya hai? Main uske hisaab se aapko behtar guide kar paunga.

entries.question: Bpt me 12 th marks ke uper addmission ho skta hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy) mein admission ke liye **sirf 12th ke marks kaafi nahi hote hain.**

KGMU mein admission ki prakriya aam taur par **Entrance Examination** par aadharit hoti hai. KGMU apne courses ke liye alag se entrance exam conduct karta hai ya state-level exams ke scores ko consider karta hai.

Isliye:
1. **Entrance Exam:** Aapko KGMU dwara aayojit entrance exam mein baithna aur qualify karna zaroori hota hai.
2. **Eligibility:** 12th mein Physics, Chemistry, aur Biology (PCB) hona aur minimum marks ki shart puri karna zaroori hai, lekin yeh sirf "eligibility" (paatra) hai, admission ka aadhar nahi.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye:**
*   Sabse pehle KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par **"Courses & Admissions"** section mein jaakar BPT ka latest **Admission Brochure** check karein.
*   Wahan aapko mil jayega ki is saal admission entrance exam se ho raha hai ya kisi aur prakriya se.

Kripya kisi bhi agent ya gair-adhikrit vyakti ke jhaanse mein na aayein. Admission hamesha official website par di gayi prakriya se hi hota hai.
